title: Park Fire, California
subtitle: 24 July – 26 September 2024
association: The NASA EONET record EONET_9035 (PARK Wildfire, Butte, California) and the interagency perimeter record 2024-CABTU-013761 give the same point of origin (39.818579°N, 121.802601°W). Only satellite detections inside the mapped perimeter (plus about 1 km for pixel size and geolocation) are attributed to this fire; 117 detections in the surrounding box were left out.

layers.uncertainty: Clouds and thick smoke can hide fires, and false detections are possible. Product versions: 2.0NRT.
